entries.description: Caught my own MIGRATIONS.md claim that preventive ENTRIES over-count preventive ACTS by one. Backwards and wrong in magnitude — the flag under-counts 4x. The wrong statement was already committed in a document that INSTRUCTS THE AUDITOR how to tally, so it would have propagated into the scoring. Stopped before it was read.

PROTOCOL.md header still read 'Nothing in this file has been measured. No experiment has run.' a full day after E5 closed and E2 session 1 ran, and status.py faithfully reported 'E2 NOT STARTED' because it derives from that prose. A deriving tool inherits the staleness of its source; prose does not fail a build.

Ruled the preventive-flag repair in scope despite the machinery moratorium: the moratorium covered elaborations, never repairs, and this is a bug in a conducting instrument. Required specimen-then-fix in the same commit, as for any gate repair.

Caught that the toolchain-bump merge question had been RE-ASKED TWICE after being answered once, and named that as the finding: a decision without its mechanical follow-through decays back into an open question. Directed execution of the standing decision instead of re-deciding it.

Executed the record-branch follow-through: pushed the annotated tag, added the outcome-vs-process README note, re-pointed 13 accountability links from the moving branch to the frozen tag, landed the destination on master as one squash commit (verified 574/574 + both gates ON THE REBASED TREE, not inherited), and redeployed.

git checkout master ABORTED PARTWAY on the read-only frozen v4.14.0 baselines, leaving a partial index of staged deletions. Stopped and ran git reset --hard before touching anything else, then redid the operation in an isolated worktree. Proceeding from a partial index would have committed spurious deletions of the migration record's own evidence.

findings.description: AMENDMENT 3's preventive flag DOES NOT MEASURE PREVENTIVES: 3 entries flagged vs 13 whose descriptions name a decline/refusal/stop-before-execution. Under-counts 4x because the field is optional and never validator-required, unlike actor and via. Any tally from the flag alone is invalid.
